opening_message: My daughter has been having a seizure for over half an hour!

disclosure_items.first_person_phrasing: She has a diagnosed seizure disorder.
We gave her Ativan under her tongue at home and it did nothing.
Her pulse was 120 at the start.
At first she was breathing 20 times a minute and it sounded noisy.
After the seizure stopped her pulse was 115.
After it stopped she was breathing 16 times a minute.
Her oxygen was 99% while she was on a high dose of oxygen.
After the seizure she could tell where the pain was and reached toward it.
